name: compare_static_and_observed_endpoints
description: Compare authenticated analyze_javascript_application and HAR Evidence, inline or by exact retained reference. No files, targets or URLs are acquired. Default summary retains the full comparison; optional view returns an endpoint-comparison page in this call (takes precedence over detail). inspect_analysis_view kind endpoint-comparison pages static-endpoints, observed-groups or matches with filters and fields. detail complete returns all facts. Pairings identify exact or inferred template-compatible basis; candidate/partial targets and ambiguous methods remain unknown. Root-relative targets need a caller-declared origin. Not-observed requires an exercised origin, every parent record retained and no excluded records; it never means hidden, unused or inaccessible. Copies no query strings, fragments, headers or bodies. Sensitive-declaration parents are refused; the shared 96 MiB representation budget includes source admission and derived state.

parameters.description: Declared Evidence fields accept complete records or {"kind":"retained-evidence","evidence_id":"ev_..."}. For a complete source, use the summary's parent_evidence_id. Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

detail.description: Summary retains the complete comparison and returns counts and source coverage. Use inspect_analysis_view kind endpoint-comparison for selected rows; complete returns all facts inline.

origin.description: Caller-declared canonical HTTP(S) origin for root-relative static targets; omit to keep their origin unknown. This never contacts the origin.

view.description: Return this selected page in the initial call, retaining the complete comparison. An explicit view takes precedence over detail.
